sections.text_helper: Section 20.3.8 "Encryption/Decryption unit" in chapter 20 (Neural-ART accelerator™ (NPU)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1016.
sections.section_content:
A low overhead/latency encryption/decryption unit based on Keccak-p[200] SHA-3
algorithm cipher, with a programmable number of rounds, is integrated in the bus interface,
and can be shared between the different stream engines. It supports both weights and
activation decryption and encryption.
